statusHistory.note: Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30, NYC cluster: fresh from-scratch research (no prior verified catalogue source). near-deep-researcher floor met: official site (nowadays.nyc/about — address, hours, programming, food partner Zumbador), The Infatuation review (Apr 2025, in-depth), NYC Tourism nightlife listing, Time Out New York (multiple pieces including NYE coverage), Yelp (238 reviews, page itself timestamped 'Updated September 2026' — strong currency signal, address/hours cross-checked and match the official site), Instagram @nowadaysnyc (124k followers, 1,483 posts, active). Reddit leg initially returned no direct hits on first pass; escalated to site:reddit.com via search index per the fallback ladder and found genuine, dated r/avesNYC and r/AskNYC threads discussing the venue as recently as 4 months ago (door policy, crowd, cover charge) and an 11-month-old thread titled 'Nowadays: Getting Vibed Check at the Door' — door/vibe-check complaints are a real, current pattern, not a one-off. Google reviews checked via web search (not full Yelp UGC render, which is JS-gated) surfaced consistent cover-charge figures (~$20-30) and drink prices (beers ~$10, cocktails ~$11+). Sourcing clears well beyond a single aggregator: official site + independent editorial review (Infatuation) + city tourism board + Time Out + UGC (Yelp, Instagram, Reddit) all independently corroborate address, hours, ownership continuity (Mister Saturday Night founders Eamon Harkin and Justin Carter) and current operating status. Trust set to auto per the multi-source trust-gate rule; proceeding straight to active in this run.
